text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that Railway Lane be designated as a through highway, which will require all intersecting streets to stop at Railway Lane. The proposed designation will clearly define the right-of-way and enhance driver and pedestrian safety.
The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated Railway Lane, from Nickle Street to Victoria Boulevard, as a through highway.
